title: What people in my community say
intro: Real WhatsApp messages and voice notes from people in my community.

receipts.alt: A WhatsApp chat. The student writes: It automated the 70 receipts I got from my client. This is something that usually takes me 3 days if I'm lazy. For it to even read my dashboard and the charts too. I'm super impressed. Chinenye replies: Yesss, it's the intelligence for me oo. It knew you already had formulars and it updated accordingly.
receipts.quote: It automated the 70 receipts I got from my client. This is something that usually takes me 3 days...

before.alt: A WhatsApp chat. A student writes: This would be better on a laptop sha. How do I use Claude on my laptop? ... I don try am. Make I see wetin go happen. Chinenye replies: This one dey sound like pessimism.
before.quote: Make I see wetin go happen.

ife-voice.label: Voice note from the same community member after she tried it, 1 minute 23 seconds. She connected the spreadsheet she had been updating by hand, and the AI filled in the records.
ife-voice.who: After: she connected the spreadsheet she had been updating by hand, and the AI filled in the records.

sochi-chat.alt: A WhatsApp chat. A student writes: Omo i am so so happy. I can manage this content work with my studies and still maintain balance. Chinenye replies about finishing 5 videos, scheduling them, and making about 10 carousel posts the day before.

sochi-voice.label: Voice note from a PhD student in my community about going from hours to minutes, 2 minutes 33 seconds
sochi-voice.who: His voice note: hours to minutes

wowed.alt: Two WhatsApp messages from my community. One says: Seeing the scheduled posts without opening Instagram. I was wowed. The other says: The fact that I can plan, draft, design and schedule posts all by prompting Claude after connecting the apps was mind blowing for me. To think that I have battled inconsistent content creation in years due to my demanding job, I found a solution today.
wowed.quote: Seeing the scheduled posts without opening Instagram. I was wowed.

apps-existed.quote: I learnt something entirely new about Automation. Didn't know those apps existed before.

buffer-sleek.alt: A WhatsApp group chat. A community member writes: I used buffer to schedule and it was so sleek. Chinenye replies that she went to the market, still prepped some meals, and had 3 posts go out automatically across Instagram and TikTok.
buffer-sleek.quote: I used buffer to schedule and it was so sleek.

life-saver.alt: A WhatsApp group chat. Chinenye writes: I love your voice over and I can see where it's stalling with the content proper. Give me some time, let me share an efficient way you can go about it. Cos I feel Broll content would work better than the images. A community member replies: You are a life saver. Chinenye then shares a walkthrough video, a free transcript tool and a free site for short video clips (links blurred).

miracle.label: Voice note from a community member, 9 seconds. He connected Claude to Gmail, and now it pulls the details it needs from their inbox and updates their calendar automatically.
miracle.note: He connected Claude to Gmail. Now it goes through the inbox, picks out the details it needs and adds them to their Google Calendar, with reminders. No more typing events in by hand.
